title: A Sign That Spells: DALL·E 2, Invisual Images and The Racial Politics of Feature Space

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the text-to-image model with an incomplete phrase ('a sign that spells') to expose hidden, system-appended racialized keywords (e.g., 'black', 'Asian', 'Africa') that override the model's latent default generation of whiteness.

Prompting the text-to-image model with an incomplete phrase ('a sign that spells') to reveal hidden, system-appended gendered keywords (e.g., 'woman', 'female') used as a quick technical fix to artificially diversify outputs.
